absolute_error_spearman.definition: Spearman rank correlation of |E-E_ref| over jointly completed, reference-valid tasks.

agreement.definition: agreement(i,j;task)=1 iff both energies exist and |E_i-E_j| <= tau_task; aggregate is the fraction over jointly completed tasks. Agreement is evidence of consistency, not correctness.

failure_set_jaccard.definition: over jointly attempted reference-valid tasks; an empty joint failure union emits null with status no_joint_failures.over jointly attempted reference-valid tasks; an empty joint failure union emits null with status no_joint_failures.

graded_residual.definition: r(solver, task) = |E-E_ref| / tau_task for completed runs.

outcome.definition: success iff a usable returned energy satisfies |E-E_ref| <= tau_task; miss iff it exceeds tau_task; indeterminate iff no usable energy was returned. Scored only on reference-valid tasks.

panel_success_rate.definition: successes divided by attempts, including indeterminate attempts, across the observed solver panel for a reference-valid task.

public_task.definition: A public task has curation_tier != test and joins to a committed problem-instance task_uuid; unjoinable attempts are never public.
public_task.spec_section: METRICS_SPEC_v1.md sections 1 and 3; ME-2 audit D1/D3

reference_uncertainty.definition: Maximum Hartree value over all occurrences in task, requirements, and features of reference_energy_uncertainty (using its stored units), reference_energy_standard_error (Hartree), and reference_energy_standard_error_hartree (Hartree).

size_band.definition: Size is stored NORB with no spin doubling: norb_le8, norb_9_16, norb_17_32, norb_33_64, norb_65_128, or norb_ge129.

solver_spread.definition: Maximum minus minimum energy over completed panel results for a task.

stratified_outcome_rate.definition: Per-solver success, miss, and indeterminate counts and rates within family/tier/size strata, with an instance bootstrap interval and a governing family interval only when at least two families are present.

task_class.definition: solved_by_all when every attempt succeeds, solved_by_none when no attempt succeeds, and contested otherwise; panel-composition-dependent.

attempt_disposition.identity: every committed non-resource attempt has exactly one disposition

public_definition.definition: A public task has curation_tier != test and joins to a committed problem-instance task_uuid; unjoinable attempts are never public.
public_definition.spec_section: METRICS_SPEC_v1.md sections 1 and 3; ME-2 audit D1/D3
